company_name: UAL Corporation / United Air Lines, Inc.

hedge_summary.note_reference: Item 7A; Note 14 - Financial Instruments and Risk Management

instrument_type_details.notes: Crude oil collars and swaps. Q1 2007: 32% hedged, crude oil collars+swaps, protection begins >$65/bbl, capped at $74/bbl, payment obligations if crude <$59/bbl. Q2 2007: 4% hedged, three-way crude oil collars, protection from $64/bbl capped at $75/bbl, payment obligations if crude <$60/bbl. 2006 recognized $26M net realized/unrealized loss from economic fuel hedges (in aircraft fuel expense). No hedges for Predecessor entity at Dec 31, 2005. UAL emerged from bankruptcy Feb 1, 2006 (Successor entity). Instruments have maturity <1 year as of Dec 31, 2006.

warnings: UAL emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy February 1, 2006 - Successor entity (fresh-start reporting); Predecessor entity had no fuel hedges at Dec 31, 2005
No gallons volumes disclosed - only percentage hedged (32% Q1 2007, 4% Q2 2007) and barrel-denominated strike prices
Net fair value of -$2M refers to all fuel derivative positions as of Dec 31, 2006
Ticker changed from UALAQ (bankruptcy) to UAUA upon emergence from bankruptcy in 2006
Volumes based on crude oil (barrels) not gallons - no conversion done as volume was not directly disclosed
